class FastIO {
public:
    FastIO() {}
    ~FastIO() {}
    void reset() {}

    template<class T>
    void read(T &x) {
        x = 0;
        char c = getchar();
        int f = 1;
        while (!isdigit(c) && c != '-') {
            c = getchar();
        }
        if (c == '-') {
            f = -1;
            c = getchar();
        }
        while (isdigit(c)) {
            x = x * 10 + c - '0';
            c = getchar();
        }
        x *= f;
    }

    template<class T>
    void write(T x) {
        if (x < 0) {
            putchar('-');
            x = -x;
        }
        if (x > 9) {
            write(x / 10);
        }
        putchar(x % 10 + '0');
    }

    void flush() {}
};

class TreeNode {
public:
    int key;
    int value;
    TreeNode *left;
    TreeNode *right;
    TreeNode *parent;
    int height;
    int num_left;
    int num_total;
};

class AvlTree {
public:
    TreeNode *_tree;

    AvlTree() : _tree(nullptr) {}

    ~AvlTree() {
        _tree = nullptr;
    }

    void add(int k, int v) {
        if (!_tree) {
            _tree = new TreeNode();
            _tree->key = k;
            _tree->value = v;
            _tree->parent = nullptr;
            _tree->height = 1;
            _tree->num_left = 1;
            _tree->num_total = 1;
            return;
        }
        TreeNode *node = addRecursive(k, v);
        if (node) {
            rebalance(node);
        }
    }

    TreeNode *addRecursive(int k, int v) {
        TreeNode *node = _tree;
        while (node) {
            if (k < node->key) {
                if (node->left) {
                    node = node->left;
                } else {
                    node->left = new TreeNode();
                    node->left->key = k;
                    node->left->value = v;
                    node->left->parent = node;
                    node->left->height = 1;
                    node->left->num_left = 1;
                    node->left->num_total = 1;
                    return node->left;
                }
            } else if (node->key < k) {
                if (node->right) {
                    node = node->right;
                } else {
                    node->right = new TreeNode();
                    node->right->key = k;
                    node->right->value = v;
                    node->right->parent = node;
                    node->right->height = 1;
                    node->right->num_left = 1;
                    node->right->num_total = 1;
                    return node->right;
                }
            } else {
                node->value = v;
                return nullptr;
            }
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    void rebalance(TreeNode *node) {
        int lh = getHeight(node->left);
        int rh = getHeight(node->right);
        node->height = max(lh, rh) + 1;
        int balance_factor = lh - rh;
        node->num_total = 1 + getNodeNumTotal(node->left) + getNodeNumTotal(node->right);
        node->num_left = 1 + getNodeNumTotal(node->left);
        if (balance_factor > 1) {
            if (getHeight(node->left->left) < getHeight(node->left->right)) {
                rotateLeft(node->left);
            }
            rotateRight(node);
        } else if (balance_factor < -1) {
            if (getHeight(node->right->right) < getHeight(node->right->left)) {
                rotateRight(node->right);
            }
            rotateLeft(node);
        }
    }

    void rotateRight(TreeNode *node) {
        TreeNode *new_root = node->left;
        if (!new_root->parent) {
            _tree = new_root;
            new_root->parent = nullptr;
        } else if (isLeftChild(node)) {
            new_root->parent->left = new_root;
        } else {
            new_root->parent->right = new_root;
        }
        new_root->right = node;
        node->parent = new_root;
        node->left = new_root->left;
        if (node->left) {
            node->left->parent = node;
        }
        new_root->left = nullptr;
        new_root->height = max(getHeight(new_root->left), getHeight(new_root->right)) + 1;
        new_root->num_total = 1 + getNodeNumTotal(new_root->left) + getNodeNumTotal(new_root->right);
        new_root->num_left = 1 + getNodeNumTotal(new_root->left);
    }

    void rotateLeft(TreeNode *node) {
        TreeNode *new_root = node->right;
        if (!new_root->parent) {
            _tree = new_root;
            new_root->parent = nullptr;
        } else if (isLeftChild(node)) {
            new_root->parent->left = new_root;
        } else {
            new_root->parent->right = new_root;
        }
        new_root->left = node;
        node->parent = new_root;
        node->right = new_root->right;
        if (node->right) {
            node->right->parent = node;
        }
        new_root->right = nullptr;
        new_root->height = max(getHeight(new_root->left), getHeight(new_root->right)) + 1;
        new_root->num_total = 1 + getNodeNumTotal(new_root->left) + getNodeNumTotal(new_root->right);
        new_root->num_left = 1 + getNodeNumTotal(new_root->left);
    }

    static bool isLeftChild(TreeNode *node) {
        return node->parent->left == node;
    }

    int getHeight(TreeNode *node) {
        return node ? node->height : 0;
    }

    int getNodeNumTotal(TreeNode *node) {
        return node ? node->num_total : 0;
    }

    void remove(int k) {
        if (_tree) {
            TreeNode *node = _tree;
            while (node) {
                if (k < node->key) {
                    if (node->left) {
                        node = node->left;
                    } else {
                        node->left = nullptr;
                        rebalance(node->parent);
                        return;
                    }
                } else if (node->key < k) {
                    if (node->right) {
                        node = node->right;
                    } else {
                        node->right = nullptr;
                        rebalance(node->parent);
                        return;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (isLeaf(node)) {
                        removeLeaf(node);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (node->left && node->right) {
                        TreeNode *next = getMinNode(node->right);
                        node->key = next->key;
                        node->value = next->value;
                        remove(next->key);
                        return;
                    }
                    removeOne(node);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void removeLeaf(TreeNode *node) {
        if (node->parent) {
            if (isLeftChild(node)) {
                node->parent->left = nullptr;
            } else {
                node->parent->right = nullptr;
            }
            rebalance(node->parent);
        } else {
            _tree = nullptr;
        }
        node->parent = nullptr;
        node->left = nullptr;
        node->right = nullptr;
    }

    void removeOne(TreeNode *node) {
        if (node->parent) {
            if (isLeftChild(node)) {
                node->parent->left = node->right;
            } else {
                node->parent->right = node->right;
            }
            node->right->parent = node->parent;
        } else {
            _tree = node->right;
            node->right->parent = nullptr;
        }
        node->parent = nullptr;
        node->left = nullptr;
        node->right = nullptr;
        rebalance(node->right);
    }

    TreeNode *getMinNode(TreeNode *node) {
        while (node->left) {
            node = node->left;
        }
        return node;
    }

    bool isLeaf(TreeNode *node) {
        return node->left == nullptr && node->right == nullptr;
    }

    void print() {
        _tree->height = 0;
        _tree->num_left = 1;
        _tree->num_total = 1;
        printNode(_tree);
    }

    void printNode(TreeNode *node) {
        if (node) {
            printNode(node->left);
            cout << "(" << node->key << ", " << node->value << ")";
            printNode(node->right);
        }
    }
};

class SegmentTree {
public:
    int _default;
    int (*_func)(int, int);
    int _size;
    int _len;
    int *data;

    SegmentTree(int *data, int default_value, int (*func)(int, int)) {
        _default = default_value;
        _func = func;
        _len = (int)sizeof(data) / sizeof(data[0]);
        _size = 1 << (int)(ceil(log2(_len)));
        this->data = new int[2 * _size];
        for (int i = 0; i < _len; ++i) {
            this->data[_size + i] = data[i];
        }
        for (int i = _size - 1; i > 0; --i) {
            this->data[i] = _func(this->data[i * 2], this->data[i * 2 + 1]);
        }
    }

    ~SegmentTree() {
        delete[] data;
    }

    int query(int start, int stop) {
        start += _size;
        stop += _size;
        int res = _default;
        while (start < stop) {
            if (start & 1) {
                res = _func(res, data[start]);
                start += 1;
            }
            if (stop & 1) {
                stop -= 1;
                res = _func(res, data[stop]);
            }
            start >>= 1;
            stop >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int powm(int a, int n, int m) {
    if (a == 1 || n == 0) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (n % 2 == 0) {
        int s = powm(a, n / 2, m);
        return (s * s) % m;
    } else {
        return ((a % m) * powm(a, n - 1, m)) % m;
    }
}

int binarySearchCount(int *arr, int n, int key) {
    int left = 0;
    int right = n - 1;
    int count = 0;
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = (left + right) / 2;
        if (arr[mid] <= key) {
            count = mid + 1;
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}
